name: quickshot
description: Fast, local-first screenshot tool for macOS and Windows with polished annotations and presentation-ready backgrounds
author: 岚叔 (https://github.com/cclank)

scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run build && npm run check:build
scripts.pack:mac:dir: npm run build:ocr-helper:universal && tsc && vite build && electron-builder --mac --dir --arm64
scripts.install:mac:local: npm run pack:mac:dir && node scripts/sign-mac-local.mjs && node scripts/install-electron-mac.mjs
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:ocr-helper:universal && tsc && vite build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64
scripts.build:mac:arm64: npm run build:ocr-helper:universal && tsc && vite build && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.build:mac:x64: npm run build:ocr-helper:universal && tsc && vite build && electron-builder --mac --x64
